messages:
Raj Patel: FYI passing BlueStream Finance (mid-market fintech) to CS after close today. TL;DR: they require Private (VPC) deployment + Okta SSO, want Dedicated capacity with a monthly commit. Contacts: Priya Sethi (Product), Omar Khan (Infra). Traffic profile: ~60 QPS peak, 200 tokens avg. SLA expectation: p99 < 350ms. Renewal is ~11mo out. Legal flagged data residency + DPA; theyll ask for SOC2 artifacts. Immediate asks: CSM owner, eng ticket for VPC peering + cert exchange, compliance enablement pack. Risk: pilot must start within 3w or exec momentum drops.

Amanda Li: I can take the CSM. Thanks Raj. Ill schedule kickoff (aim wk of 1777777080) and draft an onboarding runbook. Need Priyas calendar invite and Omars Okta admin contact.

Raj Patel: Adding contacts: priya.sethi@bluestream.com, okta admin omar.k@bluestream.com. Pilot target: 2 weeks from now. Contract signed; billing monthly commit. Legal route started.

Leo Kim: Eng: will open an infra ticket for VPC peering and TLS cert exchange. Can you confirm CIDR ranges and whether they require private egress? Also: do they want model pinning (to a specific quantized build) or allow runtime routing to cheaper variants? Pinning needs a 4-day build window. Tagging @Maya for support inputs.

Maya Gomez: Support: Ill own onboarding runbook + post-prod playbook. Need list of Edge / SRE contacts, expected SLOs, log access method (S3 vs streaming), and retention policy for prompts. Propose a pilot incident run (tabletop) in week 2.

Katie Chen: Customer success ops: renewal-risk medium-high unless we surface measurable wins quickly. Recommend: weekly exec sync Amanda<>Priya for first 6 weeks + success dashboard (latency, cost per 1k tokens, accuracy). Ill prep the enablement pack for infra & compliance.

Hana Park: Legal: Im the lead. We have a DPA template ready; will compile SOC2 artifacts. ETA to customer ~5 business days after docs pulled from vault. Please tag me on any scope changes that affect data flows.

OnboardBot: CHECKLIST CREATED  Kickoff requested (wk 1777777080), VPC peering form submitted, Okta metadata request sent, Dedicated capacity pre-reserved, SOC2 request logged. https://internal.redwood/bluestream/onboard

Raj Patel: Updated CRM: Amanda = primary CSM; attached contract & SOC2 note. Thanks team.

Amanda Li: Next steps / owners recap:
- Amanda Li: kickoff scheduling, onboarding runbook, weekly exec syncs
- Leo Kim: open eng ticket (VPC peering, certs, build estimate for pinned model)
- Maya Gomez: create support runbook & pilot incident drill
- Katie Chen: success dashboard + enablement materials for infra/compliance
- Hana Park: pull & deliver SOC2 artifacts, DPA next steps
Ill create a shared doc and ping owners on blocked items. :thumbsup:
